The probability of drawing exactly 4 red marbles is $\frac{\binom{r}{4} \binom{b}{3}}{\binom{n}{7}}$. The probability of drawing exactly 5 red marbles is $\frac{\binom{r}{5} \binom{b}{2}}{\binom{n}{7}}$.
